# proxcenter_vms (Data Source)

QEMU VMs of a connection the token sees, e.g. to find a template for source.clone_of. Needs vms:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxcenter_vms" "templates" {
  connection_id = data.proxcenter_vdc.prod.connection_id
}

output "template_vmids" {
  value = [for vm in data.proxcenter_vms.templates.vms : vm.vmid if vm.template]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) Cluster connection.

### Optional

- `vmids` (List of Number) Only these VMIDs.

### Read-Only

- `vms` (Attributes List) The VMs; the list ProxCenter serves may lag a few seconds behind Proxmox. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) VM name.
- `node` (String) Node it runs on.
- `status` (String) running, stopped...
- `template` (Boolean) Whether it is a template.
- `vmid` (Number) VMID, the source.clone_of of a clone.
